work_items.title: Implement physical Migration 1 platform foundation
work_items.objective: Create the smallest locked Supabase/PostgreSQL application-identity foundation without crossing into authorization profiles or later P1 migrations.
in_scope: public.users application identity
Server-generated UUID and timestamp behavior
Restricted shared updated_at trigger function
Explicit table grants and immediate RLS
Reviewed persistent application and sanitized validation evidence on Rosuno Staging
Official Supabase CLI migration-history reconciliation without rerunning migration SQL or directly editing history
out_of_scope: Capabilities, session binding, jurisdiction, policy, verification, intake, referrals, scheduling, consultation, communications, financial, compliance, and California regulatory-mode relations
Authentication workflows, application code, product UI, providers, seeds, production deployment, and P2
acceptance_criteria: The migration creates only public.users and the shared timestamp trigger function
One application User per auth.users identity is enforced
Account lifecycle values, server UUIDs, server timestamps, and timestamp updates are database-enforced
RLS is enabled and anon has no table access
Authenticated access is limited to selecting the caller's own identity row
Direct authenticated writes and direct execution of the trigger function are denied
The P0 ensure_rls trigger and restricted rls_auto_enable grants remain unchanged
Persistent Staging application occurs only after protected human review
P0 and reviewed P1 migration history is reconciled without retaining the generated migration version
Post-application schema, row count, RLS, policy, trigger, function, grants, drift, and security-advisor checks pass

work_items.title: Define the authorization foundation without granting access
work_items.objective: Record the smallest locked 1B authorization foundation and its persistent Staging validation while preserving protected human review before merge.
in_scope: client_profiles, attorney_profiles, and staff_profiles
Stable capability definitions keyed by capability code
Capability grant history and nullable pre-jurisdiction reference
Application session metadata with opaque non-secret reference
Server-generated UUIDs/timestamps, restrictive relationships, lifecycle and validity constraints
Explicit RLS, relationship-based authenticated profile reads, and least-privilege ACLs
One CLI-generated ordered migration artifact and sanitized persistent Staging evidence
Deterministic read-only catalog fingerprinting and exact advisor-exception enforcement
out_of_scope: Jurisdictions or a jurisdiction foreign key
Authorization helper functions, SECURITY DEFINER functions, authentication workflows, account recovery, application code, UI, providers, seeds, and later P1 objects
acceptance_criteria: The CLI-generated migration creates only the six bounded 1B tables and the required capability-grant index
Every profile has one restrictive unique relationship to public.users and attorney/staff lifecycle values are database-locked
Optional numeric values, capability grant history/validity, opaque session references, and session time constraints are database-enforced
RLS is enabled on every new table; authenticated may select only its own three profile rows and may not write
Anon and authenticated have no capability or session access; service_role has only SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE and no DELETE
capability_grants.jurisdiction_id remains nullable without a foreign key until locked Migration 3
No capability or entity rows are seeded and no P0/P1-001 object, ACL, policy, function, trigger, data, or history is changed
Persistent Staging evidence validates constraints, privilege boundaries, exact migration history, unchanged non-target environments, and no database repair
The advisor gate accepts exactly three stable default-deny findings and rejects every unapproved finding
Three independent read-only catalog runs reproduce the deterministic SHA-256 baseline
The Supabase CLI OCI limitation is documented without claiming a clean CLI drift result
The migration remains pending protected human review with no release record

work_items.title: Define the jurisdiction-neutral regulatory control plane
work_items.objective: Implement locked Physical Migration 3 without inventing counsel-gated values, making gate completion equivalent to launch authorization, or crossing into a later P1 group.
in_scope: Jurisdictions and jurisdiction-scoped service areas
Regulatory modes and effective-dated jurisdiction relationships
Policy types, effective-dated policy versions, and verified authority provenance
Launch gates, evaluation history, and explicit launch-authorization history
Deferred restrictive capability_grants jurisdiction foreign key
Explicit RLS, default-deny client boundary, and least-privilege server ACLs
One CLI-generated ordered migration artifact, protected review, persistent Staging application, and sanitized final acceptance evidence
out_of_scope: California-specific columns, regulatory-mode rows, policy rows, launch-gate rows, or other counsel-gated values
Attorney service-area participation, attorney verification, eligibility, referrals, intake, scheduling, consultations, communications, financial objects, and every Migration 4 or later object
Authentication workflows, application code, product UI, providers, fake data, production deployment, and P1-004 or later work
acceptance_criteria: The migration creates exactly the ten bounded Migration 3 tables and the deferred restrictive capability-grant jurisdiction foreign key
No California-specific schema element, counsel-gated configuration value, policy, jurisdiction, capability, launch gate, or other business row is seeded
Jurisdiction lifecycle is jurisdiction-neutral and LIVE requires a separate active human launch authorization
Policy history remains reconstructible by explicit version, scope, status, and effective period rather than a latest-row shortcut
A policy cannot enter an approved-or-later state without an approving user and at least one verified human authority reference
RLS is enabled on every new relation; PUBLIC, anon, and authenticated have no table privileges or client-facing policy
service_role has only SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE and no DELETE on every new relation
Rollback-only Staging tests cover valid configuration, invalid lifecycle/effective periods, missing policy provenance, and missing launch authorization
Rollback leaves migration history, P0, P1-001, P1-002, rows, objects, grants, functions, and triggers exactly unchanged
Protected human review and separate post-merge authorization precede persistent Staging application
Final Staging acceptance proves exact migration history, catalog structure, default-deny security, zero seed data, unchanged prior controls, and zero unapproved advisor findings
